noAIHostedAcceptance.checks: Existing all-role private-access denial plus explicit relationship access; old links close on removal, remain closed after re-addition, fresh replacements work and close on second removal through both stable public readers.
noAIHostedAcceptance.cleanup: Exact fictional student/intake/report/relationship IDs; truthful versions and four known share IDs cascade from the exact report. Caller readback plus independent privileged read-only exact-ID absence proof required.
noAIHostedAcceptance.capabilities: Link token values never written to receipts/evidence; tracing/video/screenshots disabled; sanitizer required before download.
